name: Miriam
overview: Miriam is introduced in Scripture as the protective sister of Moses, who watched over him when he was placed in a basket along the river, thoughtfully arranging for their mother to nurse him (Exodus 2:4-8). She is also recognized as a prophetess who led the women of Israel in worship and celebration after God’s deliverance from Pharaoh’s army (Exodus 15:20). These passages highlight Miriam’s pivotal role in preserving God’s chosen deliverer and leading the people in joyful praise.
